items.text: Tout était parfait !  Nous étions 11 et tout le monde était enchanté. P.e juste préciser qu'il y a deux logements dans l annonce. C'est un détail mais quand on lit l'annonce,  on pense que toutes les chambres sont au même étage. Vraiment un détail pour nous. Nous n'avons pas utilisé la salle à manger. Très heureuse d'avoir séjourné dans cet endroit un peu hors du temps !  Hyper bien situé.  On sait tout faire à pieds  !

I don’t even know what to start with. This was so far the best place we’ve ever visited. Everything was much more than we expected. The apartment is sparkling clean, amazing location-only 10 min walking distance from downtown so you still get the privacy and quietness. This is not just an apartment that you rent, this feels more like a full equipped home. There’s was all the different types of cookware you could imagine, pantries full with complimentary treats, fridge full with complimentary drinks, there was even a flavor you can put on your popcorns.. stuff I don’t even have in my home. Little travel size personal care products you might’ve forgot to bring! Easy communication with the host, flexible check in and out time. Nice and helpful tips to get around the city. We’ll definitely visit again. Great value!

Een heel fijn, ruim en schoon appartement. Ook erg prettig dat er een garage bij zit waar we onze auto in konden zetten. Sam is heel behulpzaam en hij reageert snel als je hem wat vraagt. Dat vind ik erg prettig. Dit appartement is een absolute aanrader. Wij gaan zeker weer eens terug. Heel erg bedankt Sam.

Wonderful apt! Host is very helpful and friendly, we love this place very much. Almost got everything we need except for the lack of a dryer but we make use of the clothing rack so it was ok. Another downside is the long stairs up to the apt. With two huge luggage it was a long way up. Other than that, everything about this apt is awesome, 10 out of 10! There is a supermarket just next door which is very convenient for us since we love to cook. And the local restaurants around all look really good, though we only got chance to try out the Mediterranean Foods restaurant, it was a delicious one. Bus stop is also right next to the main entrance, which makes it super easy to hop on and get to the city center. And I have to mention that the host is so very helpful and fast in response, definitely one of the best I’ve encountered. If you are visiting Wellington, try this place out, you will not regret it.

Love 12 South and the Belmont area! Such a beautiful fun area! Centrally located and easy to get everywhere. The house is old but very charming. We have been to Nashville about 10 times over the past couple years as our daughter has been in graduate school and just graduated!! We’d  definitely  recommend this house and location to friends!! We hit our favorite spots, Buttermilk Ranch, 5 daughters bakery, Edley’s, and the Cheesecake Factory. Thanks for the special touches throughout your home!

Jacob’s place was everything we could have wished for and more for our spring break trip to Nashville. The house was extremely clean and we really appreciated the chalk board and book of things to do and places to visit. The Jackson was a quick 10 minute drive to Downtown and located on a quiet road. we really enjoyed our stay in Nashville and the house really enhanced our experience. We look forward to staying there again in the future!

Pal is a great host with a lot of knowledge about the Marigny area and local restaurants, bars and coffee shops to check out. The location cannot be beat if you want to experience an authentic New Orleans neighborhood full of fantastic restaurants and bars. Walking distance to Frenchman Street and French Quarter but far enough away from the craziness to feel like a getaway. Also relatively close to the Bywater which offers amazing art galleries, bars and restaurants. The room was impeccably clean, private and spacious. Highly recommend

Faye is an amazing host, kind and always keen to help you out. Location is perfect, close to the beach, to Coles and to a car rental so that’s perfect. I’m giving 4 stars out of 5 only because there’s no wifi in the house which was pretty annoying. I understand that it’s my fault 100% as I should’ve checked but this is the first house without wifi I’ve ever come across in many years of AIRBNB. I needed wifi network for work purposes as well so I was pretty frustrated.  Anyway, other than that if you think you won’t need wifi access at all go for this unit and for this host. Cleanliness, kindness and location are over the top!!!

Awesome stay!  Would highly recommend. I think another five star review said the pictures didn’t due the place justice and we would have to agree. Would give six stars if we could. And my kids loved the fish!

A Marina foi ótima desde quando começamos a conversar! Quando chegamos fomos recebidos com dicas, mapas e ela esteve o tempo todo à disposição. O apartamento é ótimo, limpo, arejado, nos acomodou confortavelmente. A localização é excelente, próximo de restaurantes, metrô, bares... a locomoção a partir dali é super fácil, e os porteiros também foram sempre gentis. Recomendo muito!

The cottage was everything I expected it to be and more. Beautiful, cozy, secluded. Jess explained everything about the property really well and was quick to answer any questions I had. I have nothing bad to say - would definitely stay here again!

The apartment was perfect. It had everything we needed and more. The most comfortable bed. We loved everything about it. The location was amazing. Right in the heart of Rome, walking distance to the Pantheon, Trevi Fountain, Spanish Steps and so much more. It is actually the absolute best location. Stefano was so helpful and responsive, a true host. We would love to stay here again the next time we visit Rome. It exceeded all expectations.

It’s a lovely cozy place and we feel very comfortable to stay here. Innes is a responsible person so the house always keeping clean. With amazing location and valuable price, we decided to extend our stay for few more weeks. And it’s very considerate that Innes gave many useful suggestions for travellers on the Airbnb manual that makes their travel gets easier. Come and discover here by yourself , I believe people who booked the stay here will find that it’s much better than their expectations!

Love the location and glad we chose it for our big family of 8! We love that it is so spacious and there’s enough space for all. Also love that all the kitchen utensils are provided for. The host is also very responsive. We had to change our travel date last minute and they accommodate to it easily. Thank you for the wonderful accommodation which made our trip even more memorable! :)

It would be grossly unfair to say that our stay at La Provence was anything less than perfect. Tom, Delphine, Lucie, Leo (the beautiful, but cheeky, Labrador) and Kevin (the goat)'s reputation as Air BnB 'Superhosts' is a tough mantle to live up to, however, having stayed for 7 nights in this delightfully tranquil, charming and serene house it does not do them justice. Tom, Delphine and Lucie opened up their home to us and clearly love meeting new people and sharing their dream house with others. They all love to have a chat with their guests without being overbearing and are happy to let you relax in peace if that's what you want. We stayed in the cottage room which was clean, comfortable and had everything that is needed for a few nights away. The property itself has a decent sized fresh water swimming pool with breathtaking views over the countryside and Mt. Warning - perfect for a quiet evening with a glass of something watching the sun set and listening to the wildlife. It would be remiss of me not to mention the simple but thoughtful continental breakfast laid out in their dining area each morning and topped off with weekend treats such as egg and ham pie (because real men do

Had an amazing time here. We only stayed for a couple of nights but wish we could have stayed longer. We were there with our two young children (7 and 4) and they loved being able to go out and run around without worrying about cars. The two cows just outside our front window were a hit (we named them Missy and Moo), and the star of the show was lucky the dog! She is such a beautiful dog and the girls completely fell in love with her! The lodge was lovely and cosy and peter greeted us with scones and tea on arrival. Lovely and peaceful place but close to lots of little towns and while there we visited tayto park. Will definitely be back!

Kay’s place is a gem! Kay made us feel so welcomed and comfortable like we had known each other for years! The apartment is conveniently located to great attractions. The Burren National Park is only a 10-15 mins drive and the Cliffs of Moher is a 35 min drive. The apartment is very clean. Bonus, there is a washer to do your laundry. The space is big and has everything you could think of! Kay also gave us fresh organic eggs from her chicks every morning along with bread and jam. Such a nice personal touch! My 22 month old son enjoyed watching the chickens! A great place for kids! Beautiful country side of Ireland. Thank you again Kay for the wonderful stay!!

Maria is a great host. Very helpful with all of our questions. Everything ran smoothly. The apt is located in a perfect spot, close to El Prado, Jardin Bonatico & Parque Del retiro. Also you can walk to plaza Mayor and mercado San miguel. Down the street you can fin several minimarts and plenty of places to eat. We ate at Chocolat, per Maria’s recomendation (the churros are great!) and also at taberna el Sur which had amazing food.  The only draw negative thing I can say about the apt, and it is not in the host’s control, is that there a couple of bars really near by which produce Noise at night but if you came to Madrid to stay out late you Might not care. Also, I used earplugs And slept like a baby. The apt was pretty Clean and I can not tell you Enough how well located it is!

The house and view is as described with tonnes of privacy. My husband and I were very happy with how fully equipped the house is, from a good hair dryer to lots of dvd to watch and waking up to a panoramic view of Bremer Bay, oh my days! My only bummer was the lack of mobile phone line and internet access so it got me a little worried if there was an emergency and I couldn't make a call out.

We had a 3 night stay at the location. The apartment looks great and the host was very welcoming and responsive  What we did not like was the fact that a couple of things were missing from the kitchen like paper towels, glasses (only 2), no dishwasher which is a nightmare when accommodating so many people, the floor was kind of dusty when we checked in, the shower drain was flooded, the shower curtain in the bathroom upstairs was missing. Additionally, we were informed upon arrival that we have to pay extra for the parking place, we have be quiet because of the baby in the next apartment and that for the amenities listed like sauna and gym you actually have to pay, they are not included in the price. It would have been nicer to have these aspects clear from the beginning (before booking the place).  However, we enjoyed our stay very much and would recommend this accommodation

My grandson and I were day tripping in Biarritz and decided to stay over night at Saint Sebastian. Lourdes thankfully accepted our request for a reservation at very late notice. Lourdes communicated everything we needed to arrive and check in seamlessly. We were welcomed and informed clearly of everything  we required. Lourdes and her home are excellent. We will definitely go back to Saint Sebastian and with luck we will request to stay with Lourdes’s again.

Expect a fantastic location, a very spacious apartment and super hosts who thoughtfully provide a guide  with their own suggestions for local restaurants, places to visit, bars etc.  Incredibly helpful so you quickly work out where you want to go, and Where to eat!  Great communication and kindly arranged for a local driver to meet us at the airport.  Terrific suggestion to use Regiojet to Vienna, an excellent train service. Location is very central on a lovely side street near the Old Town Square.  There is some street noise at night from people leaving the square but one of the bedrooms is set back on the quiet side of the block.  Super restaurants and bakeries on every corner.  Loved our hosts for being so helpful! Thank you. Easy walking distance to everything.  Beautiful rooms, great bathrooms and showers.
Nicole’s place was fantastic! Great location and extremely convenient for getting on and off the Metro. We felt very safe and comfortable there!
We had a pleasant stay at Nacho's with lots of local tips. The place is spacious and nicely decorated.  Location is super central, perfect if you want to explore the city.

The apartment is very clean and comfortable and located in one of Paris’ prime areas. Bastille and the 11th a have great food and serve as a good place to branch out for sights and exploration. The host is very accommodating - thanks for everything!
Very nice place, as described, Toni was very responsive and caring, would reccommend and come again.

My group just needed a place to stay for the weekend that wasn't too expensive, so we were not expecting much. We were honestly taken by surprise by how nice this stay was for the price and the location. The hosts put so much thought into the details and are very personable and responsive.  The smart locks and exterior camera made me feel safe and comfortable with leaving my bags and personal items inside, and I also felt great due to how clean it was. Not a crumb of dust and dirt was left behind. The hosts did NOT have a HUGE list of chores like other tacky Airbnb hosts usually do. THANK YOU.  I usually stay in the hotels connected to the convention center when I stay in Columbus, but since we had a bigger group that didn't really want to share rooms, this was perfect and well worth the less than TEN MINUTE drive over to the center. We will definitely be returning to this house for events in the convention center in the future. Thank you so much for your hospitality.
Sabina is very friendly and communicative and the place is very clean, and beautiful. Wonderful area to stay in London too!

We enjoyed our stay there ! Jose is very helpful. The flat is very well located near the city center, shopping streets, main places to visit... We did everything by foot. The flat is exactly as described on the website, very pleasant. It is also very noisy because of the very busy road. Bring your ear plugs ! I recommend !

This place is as beautiful as the pictures - literally what you see is what you get! The views of the bay, ocean and cityscape at the same time are breathtaking and it could not have been a better location - this corner unit must be the best unit the building!!! The location was in the heart of it all and the amenities did not disappoint. We loved our stay and can honestly say this one of our best vacations. Alfonso was very responsive and kind and we will 100% want to book this place every time we come to Hollywood, FL. The only reason I am not giving 5 stars across the board is due to the fact that the staff at the front desk made us wait 40 minutes before checking in - even though our host had even offered to let us check in early.

Ed was perfect host just because his interest and taking care how is your feels:) I have to said its perfect because area was great and very safe and very easy to find. Others; place was nice and confutable for 2 person, building is great so everything is perfect thanks again ED.

We had a wonderful stay at the house of Rupert and Rita. It is a really nice place, modern and full of light in a quiet area of Fulham close to the river. It is clean and looks exactly like the pictures. Wifi worked well. It was our first experience with AirBnB and we felt fortunate we encountered such a relaxed and easy-going couple. They made us feel very welcome in their home and had good recommendations for nearby pubs and restaurants. With the bus, the tube station was about 10 minutes away and it took us about a half hour to get to the center. Our stay could not have been better.

I was really happy with my decision to stay at Caitlin's place.  I wanted easy and close transportation to Manhattan, especially at night.  Her apartment is on the top floor so it gets lots of light and is quiet.  The room is large, airy and clean -- just as the photo shows.  Caitlin is a great host, thinking of ways to make you comfortable and offering tips that only local would know.  Her apartment building is vintage so staying in her home has much more atmosphere than being in a hotel room.  There are lots of shops nearby [including places to buy healthy take-out food] and lots of restaurants, too.  You are staying in her home, so the bedroom door doesn't have a lock...just as it doesn't have in my own home!  This was my first Airbnb experience and it couldn't have been better!

Merve is a very very good host alongside with her fiancé and brother. the house is clean and comfortable to stay. Distance is close to Istikal Street and very very nice place to stay! Would definitely make it a first choice accommodation again for my next Istanbul trip!

Great place to stay when visiting Milan. Alessio was a very good host. Instructions for check in were clear, apartment was very clean and he always responded right away to any questions we had.  The place is a nice short walk to the metro and we felt very safe in the neighbourhood. Would stay here again.
Great little apartment, in a great location. Nuno provided us with good information about what to do.

Good value. Proximity to Metro and train invaluable for the itinerary during our stay. photos are representative/accurate except the apartment seems larger in photos. Nice appliances and appropriately outfitted kitchen - appreciated the coffee starter kit. If you like ice cubes - bring/buy  a few trays. The boulangerie by the front door mentioned in the reviews that we were excited about was out of business, but nice cafés a few doors down and Monop (neighborhood grocery store) less than a block away was helpful - pay attention to the hours (larger one also nearby which we didn’t need to go to), all night convenience store 2 doors down. Fans provided for 2 of 3 rooms during the heat wave.  Another fan and ceiling fans would be a nice add on although the heat wave was unprecedented.  The building interior was more run down  than expected with one off-putting resident and a few suspect tailgaters, but there are 2 security code doors in the foyer and the police station is next door - no fewer than 4 police cars parked on the street outside every night. Prepare to walk about 10 minutes to access the key and press both buttons on both sides of the lockbox to open.  Apartment clean; line

Ignasi and Shalili are truly amazing hosts!! I spent a week in Barcelona and after changing from hotel to hotel it was so nice to find a great home away from home. Communication with the hosts was both easy and informative and I was greeted with a warm welcome from Shalini on my arrival and she was really helpful in showing me around and giving me lots of valuable information about this beautiful city. I was treated to a nice bottle of cava as well as some local fare and had a great nite out in El Born with some lovely people. As for the house its exactly as described with a beautiful open and airy feel, large private bathroom and separate balcony garden. The kitchen has all you will need and overlooks a really nice square providing a true connection to the city. The location was awesome with everything at your doorstep and the beach a 15 minute stroll away. It was a pleasure to stay there so much so I returned with my partner after travelling around Spain and would definitely be back again when visiting Bcn. Great people...great place...great time!!! Stay here if you visit. Thanks heaps..Andrew:)
Nadege is a great host and very nice. Was here for a quick trip and enjoyed the area. Nice bars and restaurants and not too far from sights.

Ninna es una anfitriona extraordinaria, se comunicó con nosotros desde el momento de realizar la reserva para que la estancia fuera lo más cómoda posible para nosotros. Accedió a que hiciéramos el check in un poco antes y estuvo pendiente de nuestra llegada. El lugar coincide con la descripción y estás a 15 minutos caminando del centro de Copenhague. Es cierto qué hay que subir 5 plantas, pero el alojamiento, la ubicación y el trato de Ninna lo valen. Volvería a alojarme en este lugar!

The location of the apartment is perfect. Walking distance to all central parts of the city. The apartment is large and light. We could easily fit 4 persons during our stay. The apartment could however have been cleaned and renovated a bit more. Some parts are a bit run down. Overall we are happy we stayed at this place during our stay.

Great stay! Close to everything! The communication was awesome. They allowed my guests and I to check in early due to us landing early. The house had everything we needed for the weekend, and close by stores to buy groceries etc! That was extremely perfect especially in such a crowded city. Make sure you calculate parking into your budget for your guests. The place has a 2 car garage, but if you have more guests, there’s street parking at the pay box. The basement is a bit chilly, but it is CHICAGO in the winter! They had throws and extra blankets, so that was perfect for us. Brandon took a chance on me due ONE bad review (this is only my second time renting off Airbnb). That took courage, and I’m grateful to have caught this listing with him! Overall, WORTH the price, WORTH the memories, and definitely WORTH a trip to Chicago!

Mary’s place has everything you need.  The House was very clean and had everything you needed.  Separate washer and dryer made washing clothes very easy.  Nice bathrooms and showers.  The House is in great location to the cliffs. Mary went out of her way and followed us to drop our car off in Doolin and the drove us to Hags Head so we could walk the cliffs without worry on how to get to our car.  I highly recommend Mary’s house and will definitely stay there again if I’m lucky enough to ever come back..  Thank you Mary!!!!!
Everything works great, the atmosphere is so good. I’m so glad that I choose this hostel for coming to dublin. Great. Thanks a million

This apartment and Danny as a host were simply fantastic. You will not find a friendlier and more helpful host than Danny. He responded very quickly to all communication, met us at the apartment to show us around, gave us some great local tips, and was available for any questions we had during our entire stay. The apartment itself was incredibly spacious and well lit with nice views from the windows and a few skylights. The beds were comfortable and the bathroom setup (shower and toilet in separate rooms) was great for three of us trying to get ready for exploring quickly in the morning. We didn't cook at all, but the kitchen was large and modern and well stocked. The location was fantastic with great restaurants and pubs literally right out the front door of the building, but being on the top floor it was never loud despite being so close to some popular places. Would certainly stay here again when I return to Edinburgh.

Nev messaged before and after we checked in to ensure everything had gone smoothly. Her place was such a cute little condo with everything we needed to be comfortable for our stay in Kona. The kitchen was equipped with all the utensils and glassware we needed. It is small, so it was just right for my husband and I. The location was absolutely the best part of our stay. The complex was literally right across the street from the ocean and a 5 minute walk from some fantastic beaches where you could snorkel and do other water related activities. The restaurants and shopping area were also a 5 minute walk away as well. We were able to find parking most nights even after return from excursions after 9:30pm. One night we couldn't but there was tons of parking right across the street. Overall, we loved our experience with Nev and loved her home. We would highly recommend her place to anyone visiting the Kona area.

Sara’s place was absolutely amazing! She supplied all of the amenities that you would need, down to the smaller objects such as; olive oil, sponges, egg whisks, laundry pods, extra hangers, ect. Sara was extremely responsive and on top of everything that we needed! I would 100% stay here again, the location was amazing! This place was right next to every restaurant on the island that was a hit! We loved how friendly the atmosphere was and how easy it was to get to the beach. This place was really a dream and Sara was too!

Close to many restaurants and the tube. Very clean, looks new! Very nice all the way around!  Smaller than expected and was disappointed that there was no microwave, toaster or a small blender. But it was in a great area and was very clean and nice.  Would stay again.
Mark is an extremely nice host. The house itself is very clean and well taken care of. We had a wonderful time. Definitely recommend to anyone who wants to have a quick stay in Auckland.

This was an amazing find!  True hidden gem in Greece! The apartment was huge and cozy, and he gave us tasty snacks and coffee. We were given wonderful local recommendations and felt welcomed from the start! Would absolutely stay here again.
